In the Scorched Earth event players are given a series of objectives to complete. Each objective is to win X battles with dominance greater than Y. The once the player completes one objective they are given the next one which has a higher dominance value. The player completes these objectives by playing normal PVP battles. In order for a battle to count towards the objective, the player must both win and THE PLAYER must have a dominance rating greater than the objective limit. The dominance rating of the opponent is not important for this event.
